_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Ships, Booklet of Inclining Experiment Data
summary: The Booklet of Inclining Experiment Data provides, in two parts, the observations, calculations, and stability or equilibrium data used to determine a ship's displacement, center of gravity, and stability characteristics.
applicable_forms: Standard NAVSEA forms used in the preparation of this report may be obtained by contacting: Naval Sea Systems Command, Code 55W4 Stability Division, NC-3 Rm 3W40, 2531 Jefferson Davis Highway, Arlington, VA 22202.
description_purpose: The BOOKLET OF INCLINING EXPERIMENT DATA consists of two parts. The Inclining Experiment Report (Part 1) contains the observations and calculations leading to the determination of the displacement and location of the center of gravity of the ship in light condition. Stability Data (Part 2) for surface ships and Stability and Equilibrium Data for Submarines contain data relative to the characteristics of the ship in the operating conditions. Preliminary reports of Parts 1 and 2 permit evaluation of the ship's stability and reserve buoyancy and may indicate the necessity for action to improve the ship, a change in policy or weight control or additional inclining experiments.
application_interrelationship: This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract. This DID supersedes UDI-E-23202 and UDI-E-23255. The reference document cited herein may be obtained by writing to: Naval Publications and Forms Center, 5801 Tabor Ave., Philadelphia, PA 19120, Attn: Customer Service.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the format specified in 096-2.129 of NAVSEA S9086-C6-STM-000/CH-096.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following as appropriate:

children.title: Part 1 - Inclining Experiment Report.
children.content:
The inclining experiment report shall contain the following pages as applicable:

NAVSEA 9290/6- Form Number and Title:
1 Title Sheet - Inclining Experiment Report, (Part 1), For Surface Ships and Submarines
2 Armament, Boats, Submarine Batteries, Ballast
3 Ship in Condition A - Light Ship
4 Change in Condition A Weight Since Inclining
5/6 Displacement and Center of Gravity As Inclined
7 Functions of Wedge Areas (as required)
8 Displacement and Center of Gravity in Conditions A and A-1
9 Weight Movements and Inclinations
10 Plot of Tangents
11 Weights to Complete
12 Weights to Deduct
13 Weights to Relocate
14 Vertical Moment of Free Surface "As Inclined"
15 Diagram Showing Location of Draft Marks
16 Remarks and Miscellaneous Calculations

children.title: Part 2 - Stability Data for Surface Ships Only.
children.content:
The stability report for surface ships shall contain the following pages as applicable:

NAVSEA 9290/6- Form Number and Title:
17 Title Sheet - Inclining Experiment Report, (Part 2), For Surface Ships Only
2 Armament, Boats, Submarine Batteries, Ballast
3 Ship in Condition A - Light Ship
4 Change in Condition A Weight Since Inclining
*Loading Conditions:
18 Ship in Condition ___ (Small Free Surface Effect), or
19 Ship in Condition ___ (Large Free Surface Effect) Excessive Trim in Loading Condition
20 Displacement and Other Curves
21 Cross Curves of Stability
15 Diagram Showing Location of Draft Marks
22 Approximate Change in Metacentric Height Due to Added Weight
23 Summary of Load Items in Condition ___
24 Details of Load Items in Condition ___
25 Correction to Righting Arms for Free Surface Effect in Condition ___
26 Tank Capacities
27 Compartment Capacities
28 Table of Frame Spacing
16 Remarks and Miscellaneous Calculations

* The standard loading conditions are:
Condition A: Light Ship
Condition A-1: Light Ship (w/o permanent ballast)
Condition B: Minimum Operating
Condition C: Optimum Battle
Condition D: Full Load Departure

children.title: Part 2 - Stability and Equilibrium Data for Submarines.
children.content:
The stability and buoyancy report for submarines shall contain the following pages as applicable:

NAVSEA 9290/6- Form Number and Title:
29 Title Sheet - Inclining Experiment Report, (Part 2), Stability and Equilibrium Data for Submarines
30 Load to Submerge Determination
2 Armament, Boats, Submarine Batteries, Ballast
3 Ship in Condition A - Light Ship
31 Detail Changes in Condition A and Submerged Displacement Since Last Inclining and Trim Dive
32 Load to Submerge at Time of Trim Dive
33 Details of Load on Trim Dive
34 Ship in Condition ___ - Surface Diving Trim
35 Ship in Condition ___ - Submerged
36 Variable Ballast in Condition ___
20 Displacement and Other Curves
21 Cross Curves of Stability
15 Diagram Showing Location of Draft Marks
37 Variable Load in Conditions N and M
38 Details of Variable Load in Condition N and M
39 Water Ballast in Main Ballast, Fuel Ballast and Safety Tanks
40 Residual Water, Water Seal, and MBT Lead Corrections
41 Equilibrium Polygon
42 Points for Equilibrium Polygon
*Equilibrium Conditions
43 Light No.1 & Light No.2
44 Heavy No.1 & Heavy No.2
45 Heavy No.1 (With Mines) & Heavy No.2 (With Mines)
46 Heavy FWD No.1
47 Heavy FWD No.2
48 Heavy Aft
49 Details of Load for Equilibrium Conditions
50 Plot of Minimum GM While Trimming Down
51 Conditions While Trimming Down
52 Ship in Condition ___ Surface Diving Trim, Ballast Tanks Flooded, One Side Only
28 Table of Frame Spacing
-- Plot of Hull and Material Compression vs Percent of Test Depth
16 Remarks and Miscellaneous Calculation

children.title: Engineering Judgement.
children.content: An opinion by the inclining activity of the reliability of the experiment.

children.title: Photographs.
children.content: Photographs of the vessel topside installations, particularly the location of inclining weights, masts, shipyard gear and draft marks, forward/aft and port/starboard, at zero inclining moment.
